title: Discrete Coefficients and Open Invariant Covers in the Homology of Ample Groupoids
summary: The homology of an ample groupoid is computed from the complex of compactly supported continuous functions on the nerve. Two hypotheses routinely imposed on this complex behave in opposite ways. We show that the comparison map from the integral chain complex tensored with the coefficient group to the chain complex with coefficients is always injective, and that it is surjective if and only if every compactly supported continuous function into the coefficient group is locally constant.
